notes: Production model: tbabs*(zpowerlw+zgauss) in 3-20 keV observed frame. Fe K-alpha rest energy 6.4 keV, narrow-core sigma fixed to 50 eV. The 3-10 keV fit is the line-band cross-check; free-width and free-centroid fits in that band are diagnostics. N_H is free in the production fit; a conservative variant freezes it to the continuum-only value. b2.pha is the official PCA background model.
galactic_nH_note: Approximate Galactic cold column toward 3C 120 (LAB/Dickey & Lockman, ~2.4e20 cm^-2). Used only for the diagnostic N_H-frozen variant that explains the larger Delta chi2 quote; the production fit leaves N_H free.
